mainTopic: Why a father can make his son a נזיר: ריש לקיש's reason of חינוך is tested against the details of the משנה and the laws of נזירות.
overview: The משנה taught that a father can make his son a נזיר. רבי יוחנן said this is a special הלכה given for נזיר. ריש לקיש says instead that the father does it to train his son in מצוות (חינוך). The גמרא tests ריש לקיש's reason with a long series of questions. Why not a mother? Why not a daughter? Why only נזירות and not other נדרים? Why can relatives object? Each question gets an answer that keeps his reason standing. Next the גמרא asks how a training-only נזירות can allow shaving the whole head, bringing חולין into the עזרה, and eating a bird killed by מליקה. The answer each time is that the איסור involved is only rabbinic, so the rabbinic מצוה of חינוך can push it aside. For the bird, this rests on רבי יוסי ברבי יהודה's view that bird שחיטה is not from the Torah. The גמרא then questions whether he really holds that, and quotes a ברייתא of his about a doubtful bird חטאת. The ברייתא continues on the next amud.

steps.title: ריש לקיש: The father does it to train his son
steps.stepSummary: ריש לקיש explains that a father can make his son a נזיר in order to train him in מצוות.
steps.simpleTranslation: ריש לקיש said: the reason is to train him in מצוות.
steps.whatsHappening: ריש לקיש gives his own reason for the rule in the משנה that a father can make his son a נזיר. This is different from רבי יוחנן, who called it a special הלכה for נזיר.
steps.deeperAnalysis: According to ריש לקיש, this is not a one-time rule found only by נזיר. It is part of the general job of training a child in מצוות (חינוך). This logical reason is what the rest of the section will test.

keyTerms.meaning: To train him (from חינוך: educating a child in מצוות)

phrases.english: Reish Lakish said:
phrases.notes: This is רבי יוסי ברבי חנינא quoting ריש לקיש; his name comes right before this, at the end of the previous amud.

phrases.english: In order to train him in מצוות.
phrases.notes: He is explaining the משנה's rule that a father can make his son a נזיר.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives a second reason, next to רבי יוחנן's 'הלכה' reason that came just before.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: A father may make his son a נזיר because of the duty of חינוך.

steps.title: Then a mother should also be able to
steps.stepSummary: If the reason is training, a woman should also be able to make her son a נזיר.
steps.simpleTranslation: If so, even a woman too should be able to!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges ריש לקיש. The משנה said a woman cannot make her son a נזיר, but training in מצוות seems to apply to a mother too.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The challenge is that a logical reason should work for everyone it fits. If training is the reason, there seems to be no cause to leave out the mother. That makes ריש לקיש's reason look like it clashes with the משנה.

phrases.english: If so,
even a woman too should be able to!
phrases.notes: The משנה said a woman cannot make her son a נזיר.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Attacks the reason ריש לקיש gave in step 1.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Training applies to a mother as well. Yet the משנה says a woman cannot do this.

steps.title: Only the father has the duty to train
steps.stepSummary: ריש לקיש holds that the duty to train a son falls on the father, not the mother.
steps.simpleTranslation: He holds: a man is obligated to train his son in מצוות, but a woman is not obligated to train her son.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that the duty of חינוך belongs only to the father. So the mother has no training reason to make her son a נזיר.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The answer keeps the training reason. It shrinks who the reason covers: only someone who actually has the duty to train can use it. Since the mother is not obligated, she cannot do this.

phrases.english: He holds:
a man is obligated to train his son in מצוות,

phrases.aramaic: וְאֵין הָאִשָּׁה חַיֶּיבֶת לְחַנֵּךְ אֶת בְּנָהּ.
phrases.english: but a woman is not obligated to train her son.

steps.triggerLanguage: סָבַר: אִישׁ חַיָּיב לְחַנֵּךְ בְּנוֹ בְּמִצְוֹת
steps.terutzResolutionType: Limits who carries the duty of חינוך
steps.terutzHavaAmina: We thought both parents have to train the child.
steps.terutzMaskana: Only the father has the duty of חינוך, so only he can make his son a נזיר.

steps.title: Then a father should also be able to do it for his daughter
steps.stepSummary: רבי יוחנן's view explains why only a son is included, but by ריש לקיש's reason a daughter should be included too.
steps.simpleTranslation: This works well for רבי יוחנן, who said it is a הלכה for נזיר. That is why it is his son, yes, but his daughter, no. But according to ריש לקיש, even his daughter should be included!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks a second question on ריש לקיש. For רבי יוחנן, a special הלכה can be limited to a son. But a training reason should work for a daughter too.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A הלכה passed down by tradition follows its own exact limits, so we just accept 'son, not daughter.' A logical reason like training seems to apply to girls as well. So the limit to a son needs explaining for ריש לקיש.

keyTerms.meaning: Here, a הלכה למשה מסיני, a law passed down from סיני

phrases.english: It works well according to Rabbi Yochanan,
who said: it is a halacha regarding a nazir,
phrases.notes: He means a law passed down to משה at סיני, without a reason given.

phrases.english: because of that:
his son, yes; his daughter, no.
But according to Reish Lakish,
even his daughter should be included!

steps.triggerLanguage: בִּשְׁלָמָא לְרַבִּי יוֹחָנָן, דְּאָמַר: הֲלָכָה הִיא בְּנָזִיר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: A new challenge to ריש לקיש, built by comparing him with רבי יוחנן.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Training seems to apply to a daughter too. So why does the משנה speak only of a son?

steps.title: The father must train his son, not his daughter
steps.stepSummary: ריש לקיש holds that the father's duty of חינוך covers his son but not his daughter.
steps.simpleTranslation: He holds: his son, he is obligated to train him; his daughter, he is not obligated to train her.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that the father's duty to train covers only his son. So he has no training reason to make his daughter a נזירה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: This works just like the answer in step 3. The training reason stays. Its reach is limited to cases where the duty really exists, so the daughter is left out.

phrases.english: He holds:
his son, he is obligated to train him,
his daughter, he is not obligated to train her.

steps.terutzResolutionType: Limits the scope of the duty of חינוך
steps.terutzHavaAmina: We thought the training duty covers daughters too.
steps.terutzMaskana: The father's duty of חינוך is for his son only, so he cannot make his daughter a נזירה.

steps.title: Then a father should be able to impose other vows too
steps.stepSummary: רבי יוחנן's view explains why the rule is only for נזירות, but by ריש לקיש's reason it should work for other נדרים too.
steps.simpleTranslation: This works well for רבי יוחנן, who said it is a הלכה for נזיר. That is why נזירות, yes, but other vows, no. But according to ריש לקיש, even vows too should work!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks a third question on ריש לקיש. If the goal is training, a father should be able to place regular נדרים on his son too, not only נזירות.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For רבי יוחנן, the special הלכה was given only about נזיר, so it stays there. Training in מצוות could happen through any נדר. So it seems strange for ריש לקיש that the משנה speaks only of נזירות.

keyTerms.meaning: Being a נזיר (no wine, no haircut)

phrases.english: It works well according to Rabbi Yochanan,
who said: it is a halacha regarding a nazir,
for this reason:
with nezirus, yes; with other vows, no.
But according to Reish Lakish,
even vows too should work!

steps.triggerLanguage: בִּשְׁלָמָא לְרַבִּי יוֹחָנָן, דְּאָמַר: הֲלָכָה הִיא בְּנָזִיר, אַהָכִי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: A third challenge, built the same way as step 4.
steps.kashyaTarget: Why the משנה limits the rule to נזירות according to ריש לקיש
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Training could be done through any נדר. Yet the משנה speaks only of נזירות.

steps.title: The משנה chose the harder case
steps.stepSummary: The משנה names נזירות as the bigger case: other נדרים surely work, and even נזירות, which brings hardship, works too.
steps.simpleTranslation: It is saying 'there is no need to say': There is no need to say vows, which bring no hardship. But even נזירות, which does bring hardship, even so he is obligated to train him.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that the משנה uses a 'there is no need to say' style. It mentions נזירות because it is the hardest case, and regular נדרים are even more obviously allowed.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Regular נדרים do not make the child suffer, so of course a father may use them for training. נזירות brings hardship to the child, so one might think a father may not impose it. The משנה teaches that even here the duty of חינוך applies, and the easier case is understood from that.

keyTerms.meaning: It is saying 'there is no need to say' (naming the bigger case to teach the smaller one)
Hardship, being made unkempt or degraded

steps.whatToRemember: For ריש לקיש, a father makes his son a נזיר because of חינוך. Only the father has this duty, and only toward his son. The משנה names נזירות as the hard case, and regular נדרים are allowed even more easily.
steps.confusionAlert: Do not read the משנה as saying other נדרים are not allowed for ריש לקיש. It names נזירות only because that case is the bigger news.

phrases.english: It is saying 'there is no need to say':
there is no need to say vows,
which bring no hardship,
but even nezirus,
which does bring hardship,
even so he is obligated to train him.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge of step 6 by explaining the משנה's wording.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Explains the משנה's wording as a 'there is no need to say' style
steps.terutzHavaAmina: We thought the משנה limits the rule to נזירות.
steps.terutzMaskana: The משנה names the harder case, נזירות. Regular נדרים are allowed even more easily.
steps.whyThisMatters: This shows that ריש לקיש's view is a broad rule about a father training his son. It is not limited to נזיר.

steps.title: How can relatives stop a father from training his son?
steps.stepSummary: רבי יוחנן's view explains why the boy or his relatives can object. By ריש לקיש's reason of חינוך, though, relatives should have no power to stop a father from teaching his son מצוות.
steps.simpleTranslation: It makes sense for רבי יוחנן, who says this is a special הלכה about נזיר, that the משנה says the boy or his relatives can object. But for ריש לקיש, who says it is for training, do relatives really have the power to tell the father, 'Don't teach him מצוות'?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges ריש לקיש again. It uses the same 'this works for רבי יוחנן, but not for ריש לקיש' pattern as before.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If the rule is a special הלכה, it can come with its own conditions, such as letting the relatives object. If the whole point is the father's duty to train his son, it seems strange that relatives could cancel it. Teaching a child מצוות is a good thing, so who are they to stop it?

keyTerms.meaning: Is it in their power? Do they have the right?

phrases.english: Granted, according to Rabbi Yochanan,
who said: it is a halacha regarding a nazir,
phrases.notes: He means a הלכה למשה מסיני, a rule passed down orally from סיני.

phrases.english: this is why the Mishnah teaches:
if he objected, or his relatives objected for him.
But according to Rabbi Yosei son of Rabbi Chanina,
who said that Reish Lakish said (it is for training),
is it in the power of relatives
to say to him (the father):
Do not teach him מצוות?!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: A new challenge in the same series against ריש לקיש's חינוך reason.
steps.kashyaTarget: ריש לקיש's view that the son's נזירות is for חינוך
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The משנה lets relatives cancel the נזירות. If the נזירות is the father's duty of training, relatives should have no right to block it.

steps.title: Training that is not important can be refused
steps.stepSummary: ריש לקיש holds that the boy does not have to accept a kind of training that is not important, so he or his relatives may object.
steps.simpleTranslation: He holds that any training that is not important is something the boy is not comfortable with, so an objection is allowed.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers for ריש לקיש. נזירות is not a necessary kind of training, so the boy or his relatives can refuse it.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Not every kind of training carries the same weight. נזירות is optional and brings real hardship. So it is not important enough to force on the boy against his will or his family's wishes.

keyTerms.meaning: He is not comfortable with it; it does not suit him

phrases.english: He (Reish Lakish) holds: any training that is not important,
he is not comfortable with it.
phrases.notes: "He" here is the boy, who does not have to accept this hard, optional training.

steps.terutzResolutionType: Limits the force of the father's duty of חינוך for non-essential training
steps.terutzHavaAmina: Any training a father gives is a מצוה that no one may block.
steps.terutzMaskana: Training that is not important, like נזירות, may be refused by the boy or his relatives.

steps.title: How can a training-only נזירות allow shaving the corners of the head?
steps.stepSummary: For רבי יוחנן, a הלכה from Sinai can allow the boy's final shaving even though it breaks the איסור of הקפה. If the נזירות is only for training, how can it override that איסור?
steps.simpleTranslation: It makes sense for רבי יוחנן, who says this is a special הלכה about נזיר: that is why the boy shaves and does הקפה. But for ריש לקיש, who says it is only to train him in מצוות, look, he is doing הקפה!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא raises another challenge to ריש לקיש. This one is about the shaving at the end of the boy's נזירות. The next step answers it.
steps.deeperAnalysis: At the end of נזירות the נזיר shaves his whole head. That normally breaks the איסור of rounding the corners of the head (הקפה). A הלכה from Sinai has the force of תורה law, so it can override this. A נזירות that exists only for training seems too weak to permit breaking a תורה איסור.

keyTerms.meaning: Because of this; that is why
He shaves (at the end of נזירות)
Rounding off the corners of the head, which the תורה forbids

steps.confusionAlert: Don't mix up the shaving here with ordinary haircuts. The problem is that a full shave of the head removes the corners of the head, and that is forbidden by the תורה.
steps.whyThisMatters: This challenge tests how strong a training-only נזירות really is, and whether it can override a תורה איסור.

phrases.english: Granted, according to Rabbi Yochanan,
who said: it is a halacha regarding a nazir,
that is why he shaves
and does rounding of the head.
But according to Rabbi Yosei son of Rabbi Chanina,
who said that Reish Lakish said:
it is in order to train him in מצוות,
but look, he is doing rounding of the head!

steps.triggerLanguage: בִּשְׁלָמָא לְרַבִּי יוֹחָנָן דְּאָמַר הֲלָכָה הִיא בְּנָזִיר מִשּׁוּם הָכִי מְגַלֵּחַ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: A fresh challenge in the same series, now about overriding a תורה איסור.
steps.kashyaTarget: ריש לקיש's view that the son's נזירות is only for חינוך
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: A הלכה from Sinai can override the איסור of הקפה. A נזירות that exists only for training seems too weak to permit breaking a תורה איסור.

steps.title: Both הקפה and חינוך are rabbinic, so one can override the other
steps.stepSummary: ריש לקיש holds that the איסור of הקפה of the entire head is only מדרבנן, and חינוך is also מדרבנן. So the rabbinic מצוה of חינוך can push aside the rabbinic איסור of הקפה.
steps.simpleTranslation: He (ריש לקיש) holds that rounding off the entire head is forbidden only by the רבנן, and חינוך is also only from the רבנן. So the rabbinic חינוך comes and pushes aside the rabbinic הקפה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the question from Step 10. It explains how the boy's shaving can be allowed even according to ריש לקיש.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The question was that something done only for training should not be able to break the איסור of הקפה. The answer is that when the whole head is shaved, the איסור of הקפה is only מדרבנן, and חינוך is also מדרבנן. Two rules of the same rabbinic strength can balance each other, so חינוך wins here.

keyTerms.meaning: Rounding off the corners of the head (shaving the sides)
From the רבנן; a rabbinic law, not a Torah law

steps.confusionAlert: This does not mean הקפה is never a Torah איסור. The claim is only that shaving the ENTIRE head (as a נזיר does) is forbidden מדרבנן, because the Torah's איסור is about the corners.

phrases.english: He holds: rounding the entire head is forbidden by rabbinic law,
phrases.notes: "He" is ריש לקיש, whose view was challenged in Step 10.

phrases.english: and training a child is by rabbinic law.
So the rabbinic training comes
and overrides the rabbinic rounding.

steps.terutzResolutionType: Redefining the strength of the conflicting איסור: both sides are only מדרבנן.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The questioner assumed the shaving breaks a Torah-level איסור of הקפה, which mere training could not override.
steps.terutzMaskana: Shaving the whole head is only rabbinic הקפה, and rabbinic חינוך can override it.

steps.title: How can the boy bring a קרבן if his נזירות is only training?
steps.stepSummary: For רבי יוחנן, the boy is a real נזיר by a הלכה, so his end-of-נזירות קרבן is a real קרבן. For ריש לקיש, the נזירות is only for training, so the animals he brings would be ordinary חולין being brought into the עזרה.
steps.simpleTranslation: It works well for רבי יוחנן, who said it is a הלכה about a נזיר: that is why when the boy shaves he brings a קרבן. But for רבי יוסי son of רבי חנינא, who said in the name of ריש לקיש that it is to train him in מצוות, then he is bringing ordinary animals into the עזרה!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא raises a new challenge against ריש לקיש. It asks about the קרבנות the boy brings when he finishes his נזירות.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If the boy is a real נזיר (רבי יוחנן), his קרבנות are required and holy. If his נזירות is only practice (ריש לקיש), the Torah never obligated those קרבנות, so they are just ordinary animals. Bringing and slaughtering ordinary animals in the עזרה is forbidden.

keyTerms.meaning: It works well, granted (opens a contrast: this view is fine, but the other is a problem)
Shaves (at the end of the נזירות)
An offering brought in the בית המקדש
The courtyard of the בית המקדש

phrases.english: Granted, according to Rabbi Yoḥanan, who said:
it is a halakha regarding a nazirite,
that is why when he shaves he brings an offering.
But according to Rabbi Yosei, son of Rabbi Ḥanina,

phrases.aramaic: אָמַר רֵישׁ לָקִישׁ, כְּדֵי לְחַנְּכוֹ בְּמִצְוֹת —
phrases.english: who said in the name of Reish Lakish: it is in order to train him in מצוות,
then he is bringing non-sacred animals into the Temple courtyard!

steps.triggerLanguage: בִּשְׁלָמָא לְרַבִּי יוֹחָנָן, דְּאָמַר: הֲלָכָה הִיא בְּנָזִיר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: After answering the הקפה question, the גמרא brings another problem in the same בשלמא pattern.
steps.kashyaTarget: ריש לקיש's reason that the son's נזירות is only for חינוך.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: If the נזירות is not real, the end-of-נזירות קרבנות are not required, so they are חולין, and bringing חולין into the עזרה is forbidden.

steps.title: חולין in the עזרה is not a Torah prohibition
steps.stepSummary: ריש לקיש holds that the איסור of bringing חולין into the עזרה is not from the Torah, so it can give way for the sake of חינוך.
steps.simpleTranslation: He (ריש לקיש) holds that חולין in the עזרה is not forbidden by the Torah.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the challenge of Step 12. It uses the same kind of answer as in Step 11.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Again the answer lowers the strength of the איסור. If חולין בעזרה is only a rabbinic איסור, the rabbinic מצוה of חינוך can override it, just as it overrode rabbinic הקפה.

keyTerms.meaning: He holds, he is of the opinion
From the Torah; a Torah-level law

phrases.english: He holds: non-sacred animals in the Temple courtyard is not forbidden by Torah law.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the קשיא of Step 12, following the same pattern as Step 11.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Redefining the strength of the conflicting איסור: it is only מדרבנן.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The questioner assumed חולין בעזרה is a Torah איסור that training could not override.
steps.terutzMaskana: For ריש לקיש, חולין בעזרה is only rabbinic, so חינוך can override it.
steps.whatToRemember: Steps 11 and 13 use the same answer: ריש לקיש's חינוך is מדרבנן, so it can only override rabbinic איסורים, and the גמרא shows that each problem is only rabbinic.

steps.title: Setting up a challenge: the bird קרבן of a boy who became טמא
steps.stepSummary: For רבי יוחנן, a boy who is a real נזיר and becomes טמא brings a bird קרבן, and the כהן may eat the bird killed by מליקה. This is the first half of a challenge that will ask how this works for ריש לקיש.
steps.simpleTranslation: It works well for רבי יוחנן, who said it is a הלכה about a נזיר: that is why when the boy becomes טמא he brings a bird קרבן, and the כהן eats the bird killed by מליקה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא is setting up its next challenge against ריש לקיש. Here it only gives the "granted" part for רבי יוחנן; the problem for ריש לקיש comes next.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A נזיר who becomes טמא brings birds, and the כהן kills the חטאת bird by מליקה, pinching its neck instead of regular slaughter. That is allowed only for a real קרבן. For רבי יוחנן the boy is a real נזיר, so it is fine; the coming question is that for ריש לקיש the bird would be ordinary, and a bird killed by מליקה is not kosher to eat.

keyTerms.meaning: Killing a bird קרבן by pinching its neck from behind

phrases.english: Granted, according to Rabbi Yoḥanan, who said:
it is a halakha regarding a nazirite,
that is why when he becomes ritually impure
he brings an offering of birds,
and the priest eats the bird killed by pinching.

steps.triggerLanguage: בִּשְׁלָמָא לְרַבִּי יוֹחָנָן, דְּאָמַר: הֲלָכָה הִיא בְּנָזִיר, אַהָכִי כִּי מִיטַּמֵּא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Opens another בשלמא challenge after the answer in Step 13; the second half of the challenge comes next.
steps.kashyaTarget: ריש לקיש's reason that the son's נזירות is only for חינוך.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: If the boy is not a real נזיר, his bird is not a real קרבן, so a bird killed by מליקה would be forbidden to eat (the explicit question follows in the next lines).

steps.title: For ריש לקיש, the כהן would be eating a נבילה
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא finishes the challenge from step 14. For ריש לקיש the boy's bird is not a real קרבן, so the כהן who eats the bird killed by מליקה is eating a נבילה.
steps.simpleTranslation: But according to רבי יוסי ברבי חנינא, who said in the name of ריש לקיש that the נזירות is only for חינוך, the כהן is eating a נבילה!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא completes the question it started in step 14. For ריש לקיש, the bird the כהן eats would be a נבילה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: מליקה only makes a bird permitted to eat when the bird is a real קרבן. For ריש לקיש, the boy is not a real נזיר, so his bird is ordinary חולין. A חולין bird killed by מליקה, without שחיטה, is a נבילה, and eating it is a Torah איסור. That seems too strong for a rabbinic מצוה of חינוך to push aside.

keyTerms.meaning: An animal or bird that died without a kosher שחיטה; forbidden to eat
Killing a bird קרבן by the כהן pinching its neck with his fingernail
Training a child to do מצוות

phrases.english: But according to Rabbi Yosei son of Rabbi Chanina
who said that Reish Lakish said (it is only for training),
here he is eating a נבילה!
phrases.notes: "He" is the כהן who eats the bird killed by מליקה.

steps.triggerLanguage: אֶלָּא לְרַבִּי יוֹסֵי בְּרַבִּי חֲנִינָא אָמַר רֵישׁ לָקִישׁ, הָא קָאָכֵיל נְבֵילָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Completes the second half of the challenge begun in step 14
steps.kashyaTarget: ריש לקיש's view that the son's נזירות is only for חינוך
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: A bird that is not a real קרבן becomes a נבילה when killed by מליקה. Eating a נבילה is a Torah איסור, which a rabbinic חינוך should not override.

steps.title: ריש לקיש holds that bird שחיטה is not from the Torah
steps.stepSummary: ריש לקיש holds like רבי יוסי ברבי יהודה, who says bird שחיטה is not from the Torah. He also holds that bringing חולין into the עזרה is not a Torah איסור. So both problems are only rabbinic, and חינוך can push them aside.
steps.simpleTranslation: He holds like רבי יוסי ברבי יהודה, who says there is no Torah requirement of שחיטה for a bird. He also holds that bringing חולין into the עזרה is not a Torah איסור.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that for ריש לקיש there is no Torah נבילה problem. By Torah law a bird does not need שחיטה at all.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If the Torah does not require שחיטה for birds, a bird killed by מליקה is not a Torah נבילה. Only the חכמים made it forbidden. Together with step 13 (חולין בעזרה is rabbinic), every problem here is rabbinic, so the rabbinic מצוה of חינוך can override them.

keyTerms.meaning: Bringing ordinary, non-holy animals into the Temple courtyard

phrases.english: He holds like Rabbi Yosei son of Rabbi Yehuda,
that there is no Torah requirement of slaughter for a bird.
And bringing non-holy animals into the courtyard is not a Torah prohibition.
phrases.notes: This repeats the answer from step 13, so now both problems are rabbinic.

steps.triggerLanguage: קָסָבַר כְּרַבִּי יוֹסֵי בְּרַבִּי יְהוּדָה, דְּאֵין שְׁחִיטָה לָעוֹף מִן הַתּוֹרָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the נבילה challenge of steps 14-15
steps.terutzResolutionType: Linking ריש לקיש to a known תנא's opinion that removes the Torah איסור
steps.terutzHavaAmina: Eating a bird killed by מליקה that is not a real קרבן would be a Torah נבילה
steps.terutzMaskana: Bird שחיטה is only rabbinic, so חינוך can override the rabbinic איסור

steps.title: Does רבי יוסי ברבי יהודה really hold this? A ברייתא begins
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks whether רבי יוסי ברבי יהודה really holds that bird שחיטה is not from the Torah. It starts quoting a ברייתא where he learns that a bird חטאת brought because of a doubt is not eaten. He learns this from a הקש comparing a woman to a man.
steps.simpleTranslation: Does רבי יוסי really hold this? But it was taught in a ברייתא: רבי יוסי ברבי יהודה says: From where do we know that a bird חטאת brought for a doubt is not eaten? The פסוק says, "and the זב with his discharge, for the male and for the female." It compares a female to a male. Just as a male brings a קרבן for a certain sin, so a female brings one for a certain case. And just as a male brings a קרבן for a doubt, so a female brings one for a doubt.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא questions the answer of step 16 and starts bringing a ברייתא from רבי יוסי ברבי יהודה himself. This step only lays out the first part of his derivation. The point of the challenge will become clear as the ברייתא continues.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי יוסי ברבי יהודה is busy proving that a doubtful bird חטאת may not be eaten. That suggests a bird killed by מליקה without being a real קרבן is a real problem, which seems to clash with the idea that bird שחיטה is not from the Torah. Here he first sets up the הקש: man and woman are alike in bringing קרבנות both for a certain case and for a doubtful one.

keyTerms.meaning: A doubt; a case where we are not sure
Learning one thing from another because the פסוק puts them side by side
A teaching of the תנאים that is not in the משנה

steps.confusionAlert: Do not think the ברייתא is talking about נזירות. It deals with a woman's doubtful bird חטאת. The גמרא uses it only to find out what רבי יוסי ברבי יהודה holds about a bird killed by מליקה.

phrases.english: And does Rabbi Yosei hold this way?

phrases.aramaic: וְהָתַנְיָא, רַבִּי יוֹסֵי בְּרַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר:
phrases.english: But it was taught in a ברייתא: Rabbi Yosei son of Rabbi Yehuda says:
From where do we know regarding a bird sin-offering
that is brought because of a doubt
that it is not eaten?
The verse says:
"And the one with a discharge, for the male and for the female,"
it compares a female to a male:

phrases.aramaic: מָה זָכָר מֵבִיא קׇרְבָּן עַל הַוַּדַּאי —
phrases.english: just as a male brings an offering for a certain case,

phrases.aramaic: אַף נְקֵבָה מְבִיאָה קׇרְבָּן עַל הַוַּדַּאי,
phrases.english: so too a female brings an offering for a certain case,
and just as a male brings one for a doubt,
phrases.notes: A man who is not sure he sinned brings an אשם תלוי.

phrases.english: so too a female brings one for a doubt.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges the answer of step 16 by questioning what רבי יוסי ברבי יהודה really holds
steps.kashyaTarget: The claim that רבי יוסי ברבי יהודה holds bird שחיטה is not from the Torah
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: He works to prove that a doubtful bird חטאת is not eaten. That suggests a bird killed by מליקה that is not surely a קרבן is truly forbidden.

steps.title: The ברייתא: a woman brings the same type for a doubt as for a certain case
steps.stepSummary: The ברייתא continues the הקש. A man brings an animal for a doubt, the same type he brings for a certain sin. So a woman brings for a doubt the same type she brings for a certain case, which is a bird.
steps.simpleTranslation: And just as a male brings for a doubt from the same type he brings for a certain case, so too a female brings for a doubt from the same type she brings for a certain case.
steps.whatsHappening: The ברייתא adds another detail to the comparison between man and woman. Her doubtful קרבן must be the same kind of animal as her certain קרבן.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A man brings an animal both for a certain sin (a חטאת) and for a doubt (an אשם תלוי). A woman such as a יולדת or a זבה brings a bird for a certain case. So the הקש teaches that she brings a bird for a doubtful case too. That is how we get to a doubtful bird חטאת.

keyTerms.meaning: Type or kind (here: animal or bird)

phrases.english: And just as a male,
from the type he brings for a certain case,
phrases.notes: For a man that type is an animal.

phrases.english: he brings for a doubt,

phrases.aramaic: אַף נְקֵבָה מִמִּין שֶׁהִיא מְבִיאָה עַל הַוַּדַּאי
phrases.english: so too a female, from the type she brings for a certain case,
phrases.notes: For a woman that type is a bird.

phrases.english: brings for a doubt.

steps.triggerLanguage: וּמָה זָכָר, מִמִּין שֶׁהוּא מֵבִיא עַל הַוַּדַּאי מֵבִיא עַל הַסָּפֵק
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the ברייתא quoted as the challenge in step 17
steps.raayaObject: A woman's doubtful קרבן is a bird, the same type as her certain קרבן
steps.raayaSupportSource: The הקש of male and female in ויקרא 15:33

steps.title: The ברייתא asks: shouldn't her doubtful קרבן be eaten like his?
steps.stepSummary: Inside the ברייתא, a question is raised. If we compare fully, then just as a man's doubtful קרבן is eaten, the woman's should be eaten too. The ברייתא starts to answer with "you say," and the answer comes next.
steps.simpleTranslation: If so: just as a male brings a קרבן and it is eaten, so too a female should bring a קרבן and it should be eaten! You say:
steps.whatsHappening: The ברייתא challenges its own הקש. Maybe the comparison should also make the woman's doubtful bird חטאת eaten. It then starts its reply, which continues in the next part.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A man's אשם תלוי is eaten by the כהנים. If the woman is compared to him in every way, her doubtful bird should be eaten too. That would contradict the very point רבי יוסי ברבי יהודה set out to prove. His answer, which begins with "אמרת", will show why it is not eaten, and that is what the גמרא's challenge depends on.

keyTerms.meaning: "You say"; opens the reply to a question

phrases.aramaic: אִי: מָה זָכָר מֵבִיא קׇרְבָּן וְנֶאֱכָל —
phrases.english: If so: just as a male brings an offering and it is eaten,
so too a female should bring an offering and it should be eaten!
You say:

steps.triggerLanguage: אִי: מָה זָכָר מֵבִיא קׇרְבָּן וְנֶאֱכָל
steps.relationToPreviousStep: An objection within the ברייתא to the הקש set up in steps 17-18
steps.kashyaTarget: The ברייתא's claim that a woman's doubtful bird חטאת is not eaten
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: If the woman is compared to the man, her doubtful קרבן should be eaten just like his אשם תלוי.
